instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium close-up at eye-level. Outdoors on a sunny day, the woman in the pink cardigan (R1) on the left hugs the man in the light blue shirt (R2) on the right tightly, smiling joyfully. The man (R2) wraps his arms around her, looking forward with a gentle smile. They are locked in a close, affectionate embrace. Bright, natural sunlight illuminates them against a softly blurred background of brick steps and lavender.
